algorithm_proof: p43:r=a^((p+1)/4); r^2=a iff a is QR. Test square directly, avoiding separate Euler power.
p85:r=a^((p+3)/8), r^2/a=a^((p-1)/4). QR gives±1; if negative,2^((p-1)/4) squares to-1 and corrects root. Neither sign implies NQR.
p81:ordinary Tonelli–Shanks invariant retained, using canonical encoded residues and encodedone; decode once at output.
Montgomery REDC/ownership/ModPow remain previous frozen proof. Added power_encoded is input/output encoded and never mixes canonical operands.
Return smaller root after canonical decode.0/1 andp2 handled first. No prime test; composite input behavior/termination not guaranteed.
